title: Calculate the factorial of 3 using a loop. (Challenge 1)
description: Calculate the factorial of 3 using a loop.
hints: Identify the main Python concept: number programs.
Write a small, direct solution and check indentation.
Compare each printed line with the expected output.
solution:
number = 3
result = 1
for value in range(1, number + 1):
    result *= value
print(result)
explanation: This exercise practices number programs. The solution uses the relevant Python feature and prints the required result.
commonMistakes: Forgetting correct indentation or punctuation.
Printing extra text that changes the expected output.
